title: Mark Tudor
text:
Email: mt112@uark.edu


I’m Mark Tudor, a sophomore studying Industrial Engineering in the Honors Program at the University of Arkansas. I’m interested in manufacturing, process improvement, and using data to solve practical problems. Outside the classroom, I serve as an Engineering Peer Mentor and work on a PepsiCo project through the McMillon Innovation Studio. I’m looking for opportunities to gain hands-on experience and continue developing my engineering skills.
